234177.note: The pin is on the group area's open meadow by the river, beside the drawn loop with its shelters.

251354.note: The pin is on the cabin beside its gravel parking pad, and the drawn Census road ends at the pad.

252280.note: The pin is on the gravel turnaround at the end of the drawn spur, with the group site's shade structure 15 m south of it in the open sand.

253457.note: The pin is in open ground between a gravel lot with a shelter and the riverside campground's loops, and which spot is the group site isn't plain. Only the highway is drawn; the campground's gravel lanes show plainly but aren't, and with the site's spot unclear they aren't traced.

10327282.note: The pin sits on the open slope 40 m northeast of a small green-roofed building at the cliff edge, which is likely the lookout. The drawn Forest Service road wanders up to 20 m off the visible track up the slope.

231934.note: The pin is on the large building beside the paved lot, where the drawn loops meet.

231967.note: The pin is at the south edge of the group camp's large green-roofed buildings, on the drawn loop through the camp.

231983.note: The lidar survey here (a topobathymetric one) has almost no ground points over the campground (0.02 per square meter, 8% of the frame covered), so the ground layers are blank at the pin and along the drawn loop; nothing can be checked under the canopy. Nothing traced.

232237.note: The pin is on the group site's gravel loop beside the creek, with a shade structure at it, and the drawn loop off the highway goes round it.

232240.note: The lidar intensity confirms the highway and the drawn dirt lane on their bands, but shows nothing at the pin, which is under the trees between them; the photo's clearings with tents and cars lie 40 to 70 m northeast, reached by undrawn dirt spurs off the lane, and which of them (if any) is the group site isn't plain. Nothing traced.

232342.note: A cleared flat under oaks with several picnic tables, reached by a short lane from the highway, shows 80 m northwest of the pin, which was on the highway's edge in chaparral; the gravel lot to the southeast has no tables.

233162.note: The cleared group area with its drawn loop shows plainly 90 m west of the pin, which was in dense brush by the creek; the pin now sits in that clearing.

233178.note: The listing's own point is within 10 m of a white-roofed house in its own yard beside the drawn road, 790 m northwest of the pin, which was on an empty juniper slope; other houses stand 50 m and more away.

233229.note: No road is drawn; the pin is on a small light roof in the forest that is likely the cabin, and the nearest drawn trail is 330 m off. The listing's own point, 615 m south, is in forest by the river.

233248.note: The pin is beside the guard station's white-roofed building, and the drawn drive off the junction reaches it.

233252.note: The lidar is sparse here (1.6 ground points per square meter) and its relief shows only the west lane and the loop at the north end of the drawn loop; the pin is under the trees between the station's several buildings (one 10 m northwest, a white-roofed one 45 m south), and nothing in the photo or the lidar says which is the guard station. Nothing traced.

233322.note: The pin is on the lookout's white building on the bare rock summit, but the drawn Census road ends 50 m northeast in the trees, and the last stretch up the rock doesn't show.

233368.note: The pin is on a small cabin roof in the trees above the river road, but the short drive to it (about 30 m, visible) isn't drawn; it is too short to be worth a trace.

233881.note: The pin is on the lookout cabin on the open ridge, and the drawn road loops round it. The listing's own point, 1.8 km south, is on a forested slope with nothing on it.

233962.note: The pin is on a bare river flat inside a bend, 70 m from the drawn road, with no building plainly at it. The listing's own point, 1.5 km south, is in forest between two dirt tracks, also with nothing plain on it.

233966.note: The pin is beside the group site's pavilion at the edge of its paved lot, and the drawn road up from the highway runs into the lot.

233984.note: The pin is at the edge of a small clearing 20 m north of the lodge's building, and the drawn Census lane ends at the meadow's drive just south of it.

233989.note: Zoomed in, the pin is already on the tower's square cab, whose long shadow falls northwest across the summit clearing; the drawn road reaches the clearing 45 m east.

233997.note: The lidar relief shows NFS Rd 4818 plainly as a crowned band with its ditches, and the drawn Census line runs 15 to 30 m west of it past the pin (the pin sits on the drawn line, not on the road); neither layer shows a group site clearing or pad near the pin, and the listing's own point is in the lake, so where the site is can't be told. Nothing traced: redrawing the road wouldn't place the site.

234006.note: The pin is in unbroken pine forest on a slope, 200 m from any drawn road, with no cabin or clearing. The listing's own point, 590 m northwest, is in forest too, so neither is confirmed.

234123.note: The pin is beside the guard station's buildings in their clearing, and the drawn lane in from the road ends at the yard.

234124.note: The pin is on the guard station's cabin in its fenced yard, and its gravel drive runs 30 m to the drawn road; the drive shows but isn't drawn.

234134.note: The pin is on a cabin's roof among the town's scattered cabins, and the drawn Census lane passes 20 m east of it.

234136.note: The pin is on the cabin among its outbuildings in the yard, and a drawn Census lane passes 20 m east; the drawn line runs up to 15 m off the visible track north of the yard.

234145.note: The pin is on the guard station's cabin, and a drawn Forest Service spur reaches it. But the spur connects to nothing: the gravel road up the valley, plain on the photo, isn't drawn, and neither is the dirt lane from it to the spur.

234165.note: The pin is under the trees 60 m east of the drawn road. The station's open meadow with a building and fence lies 50 to 100 m northwest, but nothing at the pin is plainly the station.

234168.note: The house, a large dark roof in its own lawn clearing, shows plainly 100 m north of the pin, which was in forest inside a drawn loop; the pin now sits on the house.

234186.note: The pin is on the lookout on the open, grassy summit, and the drawn road up the slope ends at it.

234212.note: The pin is on the cabin among its outbuildings. The drawn road passed 80 m east, so the gravel drive from it to the cabin's parking pad, plain in the open, is traced.

234250.note: The pin is on the guard station's red-roofed building in the trees, and the drawn lake road passes 20 m east with a visible drive to it.

234251.note: The pin is in the station's gravel clearing in the forest, where the drawn lane ends; small buildings show at the clearing's east edge.

234266.note: The pin is in the guard station's yard between its green-roofed building and the cabins, and the drawn spur off the valley road ends at it.

234272.note: The pin is on the big house's dark roof in its clearing, and the drawn loop drive off the lane passes 20 m south of it.

234291.note: The lidar relief shows a levelled strip about 70 m long and 12 m wide under the trees, with crisp banks, running northeast from the road, and the photo shows pale gravel through the gaps along it; the drawn spur runs down its middle and the pin sits at its south edge, which reads as the group camp's pad and parking. The drawn road in follows its graded band. Nothing traced.

234294.note: A small round yurt with its deck shows at a bend of a dirt road, 30 m west of the listing's own point; the pin was 2.2 km southeast in unbroken forest.

234295.note: No road is drawn: the pin is on a small light roof on the open bench above the forest, and a drawn trail passes 4 m away. A faint track runs along the bench but can't be followed to a road in this frame.

234296.note: The pin is on the lookout on the rocky high point, but the drawn Census road passes 50 m west, and no track from it up to the lookout shows plainly.

234301.note: The pin is on the house at the station's yard among its outbuildings, and the drawn roads through the yard pass 25 m east.

234303.note: The pin is beside the cabin's buildings at the meadow's edge, and the drawn road runs right past them.

234304.note: The pin is beside the cabin's green roof in a small clearing, and the drawn Forest Service road ends at the clearing 15 m south.

234306.note: The lidar survey is sparse here (0.47 ground points per square meter, and it misses the river edge); its relief shows the paved loop and lot by the highway and a level bench above them where the pin sits, with a faint path round its rim 5 to 15 m from the drawn trail loop, but no group site clearing or lane onto the bench shows plainly. Nothing traced.

234316.note: The pin is beside the guard station's green-roofed building by its tree, and the drawn road up the draw ends at it.

234318.note: The pin is on the small cabin in its fenced yard in the open meadow, and the drawn Forest Service track passes 15 m south.

234339.note: The pin is on the cabin's light roof in a small clearing in the forest, but the nearest drawn road is 60 m south, and the drawn Census spur toward it ends short; no lane to the cabin shows plainly through the trees.

234372.note: The drawn track ends at the pin, where the photo shows a small light roof beside a vehicle among the trees and the lidar shows a bright levelled patch (a gravel or bare pad in the intensity, flat in the relief) about 20 m across; that reads as the cabin's yard, though the roof is too small to be plainly the cabin. Nothing traced.

234387.note: The pin is on the lookout's site, a small structure at the end of the drawn spur on the burned summit.

234399.note: The pin is on the lookout's white building on the bare rock summit, and the drawn road up the ridge ends 15 m south of it.

234415.note: The pin is on a small white building in a forest clearing on the valley floor, likely the cabin, but the nearest drawn road is 120 m west across the trees and no lane to it shows. The listing's own point, 700 m north, is on a burned slope with nothing on it.

234416.note: The pin is beside the cabin and its outbuilding in the open clearing, where the drawn Census lane ends 15 m south.

234426.note: The pin is on the bare rock summit, where a small dark structure shows, but no road is drawn within 300 m and no trail within 200 m.

234430.note: The pin is beside the lookout's dark structure at the edge of the summit, at the end of the drawn road along the ridge. The listing's own point, 980 m southeast, is in unbroken forest.

234432.note: The pin is beside the lookout's dark structure in the summit meadow, and the drawn road loops up to it. The listing's own point, 370 m west, is in unbroken forest.

234434.note: The pin is on the lookout building in the summit clearing, inside the drawn loop at the end of the road.

234438.note: The pin is on the cabin's white roof in its yard, beside the drawn drive off the valley road.

234439.note: The pin is on the cabin at the meadow's edge, with the bunkhouse beside it, but the drawn road passes 40 m west and the visible lanes from it into the yard aren't drawn.

234451.note: The pin is beside the cabin's dark roof at the forest edge, and the drawn spur off the road loops down to it.

234458.note: The photo shows the east side of the drawn loop as a dirt track up from Big Meadows Road, and the lidar intensity a lighter gravel patch under the pines south of the pin, but neither layer shows the west side of the loop as a lane, nor a cabin or a plain pad at the pin (the relief there is only a faintly levelled area). Nothing traced.

234462.note: The pin is on the guard station's cabin at the meadow's top, and the drawn road through the meadow passes right beside it.

234477.note: The pin is beside the lookout's buildings in the burned clearing, and the drawn road ends at them 15 m northeast.

234507.note: The pin is on the lookout's white building in the summit clearing, at the drawn loop that ends the road up the mountain.

234515.note: The pin is on the cabin at the meadow's edge, and the drawn road loops round its yard.

234520.note: The pin is on the cabin's green roof in the meadow, beside the drawn road that passes 10 m west.

234521.note: The listing's own point is on a teal-roofed cabin in its fenced yard just above the end of a drawn loop drive, 860 m west of the pin, which was in an empty meadow.

234522.note: The pin is on the cabin's green roof in a clearing in the open pines, inside the drawn loop drive up from the highway.

234523.note: The pin is beside the cabin's buildings, inside the drawn loop drive off the valley road.

234531.note: The pin is in an empty wet meadow; 270 m northeast, where the drawn spur ends, a dark-roofed building with parked vehicles stands at the edge of trees and another structure shows under them, so which one is the guard station isn't plain.

234566.note: The pin is on a small light roof in a gap in the trees, likely the station, with a drawn road 20 m east. The visible dirt loop lane west of it isn't drawn. The listing's own point, 1.6 km north, is on an empty slope.

234569.note: The pin sits on the drawn road through the middle of the station's buildings, 10 to 40 m from each; which building is the guard station isn't plain.

234570.note: The pin is in open grassland above the drawn loop; several small structures line the drawn road 30 to 170 m east, and none is plainly the guard station.

234582.note: The station's white-roofed building in its fenced yard shows 50 m northwest of the pin, at the end of the drawn road; the pin was in an empty wet meadow.

234611.note: The pin is on the rangers' cabin among the station's buildings, and the drawn loop drive ends at it.

234621.note: No road reaches it, but the pin is on the lookout's small structure in the rocky summit clearing, with a drawn trail 16 m off; the nearest drawn road ends 120 m north.

234630.note: The pin is at the forest edge by a meadow, and no building shows at it. A drawn spur ends 100 m west under the trees, where nothing shows either.

234750.note: The pin is in the open pines among the group site's parked trailers and gravel pads, but the drawn Census road passes 40 m south, and the lanes into the site that show aren't drawn.

234784.note: The lidar relief shows the campground lane as a smooth band from Icicle Road down the west side of the loop, and the drawn lane follows it within a few meters; the pin sits on a wooded mound inside the loop, with a large level open area (bright in the intensity) 15 to 60 m south of it. Which of these is the group site can't be told, so the pin isn't plainly right. Nothing traced.

250012.note: The pin is beside the lookout's dark structure in the summit clearing, at the end of the drawn spur off the ridge road.

250038.note: The pin is beside the cabin's roof in its clearing at the forest edge, and the drawn road ends 30 m northeast; the last stretch shows plainly.

251764.note: The pin is in the open meadow of the group site, on the drawn road through it, with a small structure 30 m north.

251855.note: The pin is on the guard station's cabin at the end of the drawn road, in its gravel yard.

264686.note: Full canopy: the pin is under dense trees inside a drawn loop by the river, and the group site's clearing doesn't show plainly.

266135.note: The pin sits on the drawn road at the edge of the large gravel lot with a blue ramada and parked trailers, which is likely the group site, 30 m northwest; the paved lane into the lot isn't drawn. The listing's own point, 380 m west, is on the highway.

272098.note: The lidar intensity shows the ranger station's lanes as grey gravel bands, and the drawn lanes follow them within a few meters; but the pin is under the trees between the station's scattered buildings (a white-roofed one 20 m southwest, a brown-roofed one 40 m southeast), and neither the photo nor the lidar says which is the cabin. Nothing traced.

273779.note: The pin is at the end of a drawn drive in the open ponderosa, between several houses 20 to 60 m away, and which is the Leopold House isn't plain.

233754.note: The pin is beside the group site's buildings on the point above the reservoir, inside the drawn loop that ends the road. The listing's own point, 22 km away, is on a farm by a highway with nothing to do with the site.
